refnamediv.refpurpose: Return the last multi curl error number

refentry.refsect1:
&reftitle.returnvalues;
Returns the multi stack's last error number, or 0 (zero) if no error occurred. This only reflects the outcome of the multi-stack functions themselves (curl_multi_add_handle, curl_multi_remove_handle, curl_multi_exec, curl_multi_setopt, curl_multi_select); it says nothing about the outcome of an individual transfer, which is retrieved with curl_errno on the easy handle returned by curl_multi_info_read.
